name: Practical Prey
summary: Vel'rin Fang needs hunters to bring tiger hides from the Echo Isles to Sen'jin Village. The Darkspear need the supplies as their numbers grow and their stores run low.

sections.title: A Matter of Survival
sections.body: The Darkspear in Sen'jin Village have to make every resource last along Durotar's harsh coast. Tiger pelts can be made into tents, blankets and armor. As refugees arrive and scouts return, the village's stores have thinned, and leatherworker Vel'rin Fang has sent hunters out for more hides.

sections.title: Balance and the Hunt
sections.body: The Darkspear leave the tigers of Durotar largely undisturbed, hunting them only when the tribe needs more supplies. Hunters cross the water to the Echo Isles to track the predators. For the trolls, the hunt also tests patience, discipline and skill in the wild.

faq.answer: Vel'rin Fang is a Darkspear leatherworker in Sen'jin Village. He sends hunters to gather hides the tribe needs for clothing, shelter and gear.

faq.q: Why does Sen'jin Village need tiger furs?
faq.answer: Sen'jin Village needs tiger pelts for tents, blankets and armor. The growing population has strained the village's stores.

faq.q: Where are the Durotar tigers found?
faq.answer: Durotar's tigers roam the Echo Isles, just off the southeastern coast of Durotar.

faq.q: Why don't the trolls hunt all the tigers nearby?
faq.answer: The Darkspear leave the tigers alone until the tribe needs more supplies. They hunt only enough to meet those needs while allowing the predators to thrive.

faq.q: Is hunting tigers significant to Darkspear culture?
faq.answer: Yes. The Darkspear see tiger hunting as a test of patience and cunning. Vel'rin once waited nearly a day in the Echo Isles before claiming his first major hunting victory.

faq.q: Why must hunters travel to the Echo Isles if Zalazane holds them?
faq.answer: Zalazane and his hexed minions hold much of the Echo Isles, but wild beasts remain plentiful. Hunting and scavenging along the outer shores still bring risks the Darkspear must take.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you hunt across the Echo Isles, a bitter reminder of the home Zalazane took from your people as you provide for the clan.
As a hunter, you know patience and precision matter. Vel'rin once tracked his prey in silence for a full day before springing his trap.
As a member of the Horde, you help supply the young Darkspear enclave and anchor the Horde's southern flank along the Great Sea.
